provenance: Rust port in cs-tools (tools/src/fs_read.rs) of the Python tool removed here, itself ported from pi packages/agent/src/harness/tools/read.ts + packages/coding-agent/src/core/tools/truncate.ts (2000 lines / 50KB, first hit wins, never a partial line). Also refuses a path whose real location leaves the workspace (tools/README.md).
description: Read a file or list a directory. Args: {path, offset?, limit?}. On a directory, returns one entry per line (directories end with /). On a file, offset is a 1-indexed line number; limit is a max line count. Output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). When truncated, the observation starts with 'lines 1-N of M — re-read with offset' so the next read is directed, not blind.

path.description: Workspace-relative path, or an absolute path inside the read-only repository snapshot.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed).

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read.
